answer: PoA binds each identity to bonded collateral, so splitting stake across juniper, umber, and ledge does not erase shared evidence. When k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise-correlated proofs trigger penalties that scale as O(k²); detection applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation making recovery worth less than the forfeited bond. Thus, adding sybils raises expected cost rather than multiplying influence cheaply.
